Earlier research at Aalto and China University of Petroleum+

Shape-memory polymer actuators

Oct 2022–Jun 2024 · China University of Petroleum / Aalto

Investigated responsive shape-memory polymers for soft actuation, with contributions to fabrication, characterization, mechanical testing, and manuscript preparation.

MXene processing

Oct 2022–Jun 2023 · Aalto University

Compared solvent-exchange conditions for MXene processing toward printed and wearable electronics.

Bioinspired adhesion

Dec 2020–Jan 2022 · China University of Petroleum

Developed gecko-inspired PDMS surfaces for reversible gripping; contributed sample fabrication, characterization, and manuscript drafting.

Hydrogels and photocatalysis

2019–2022 · China University of Petroleum

Investigated PNIPAM-based nanocomposite hydrogel actuation and oxygen-vacancy/heterojunction effects in BiOBr photocatalysts.

06 / About

A path across
materials and places.

I am a Mechanical Engineering PhD researcher at North Carolina State University, advised by Prof. Arun Kumar Kota. My research centers on functional polymer surfaces, responsive materials, and adhesion.

My training spans materials science, chemical engineering, and applied physics, with research experience in China, Finland, and the United States.
